finding_reverification.status: ADDRESSED FOR FINITE CALLER TERMINAL BEHAVIOR
finding_reverification.evidence: document-network-transport.ts:24-75 races setup against abort and its per-run deadline, including a stalled acquire or setup command. document-network-capture.ts:315-339 bounds Page.reload; :60-107 bounds hook removal and lease release with the same deadline. run-interactive.ts:360-376 awaits close before resolving or rejecting; those close paths now settle even when hook removal or owned detach never settles. The transport can return during stalled setup before cleanup is confirmed and says so in its timeout remedy.
finding_reverification.limit: A Chrome command that never returns cannot prove hook removal or free a pending debugger attachment; the caller is terminal and receives an unconfirmed-cleanup remedy. The installed extension was not exercised in this lane.

new_breakage_in_fix_diff.title: Rejected Chrome detach is reported as confirmed cleanup
new_breakage_in_fix_diff.evidence: cdp/client.ts:331-357 catches a rejected chrome.debugger.detach and returns { ok: false, reason }. acquireSession.release at :319-328 awaits detach but ignores that result and resolves void. document-network-capture.ts:91-101 therefore sets released=true and can return successful close despite Chrome rejecting owned detach. The saved UI may show captured rows and an OK health update while the debugger attachment is unconfirmed. Current tests model a never-settling detach, not a rejected detach.
new_breakage_in_fix_diff.remedy: Propagate detach's unsuccessful result through lease.release so close reports cleanup unconfirmed. Exercise a rejected detach through the real saved-run caller and assert no rows or OK health update.

verdict_b_details.positive: Actual saved-run callers reach finite outcomes for stalled setup, reload, hook removal, and detach. Lease state prevents an old lease from releasing a replacement attachment, and borrowed attachments are not detached on lease release.
verdict_b_details.important: A rejected owned detach currently masquerades as successful release and can misreport recipe health.
